title: HEART-Bench: Do LLMs Make Persona-Consistent Decisions?
abstract: arXiv:2605.30058v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM agents in interactive entertainment and social applications, including companions, role-play characters, and persona clones, need decisions grounded in personality and past experiences. We introduce HEART-Bench to evaluate memory-grounded persona-consistent response selection. The benchmark combines 11 Big Five-anchored synthetic characters, each with 1,000 autobiographical memories, and 64 DIAMONDS-guided decision scenarios into 673 multiple-choice questions. Domain experts independently compare candidate responses, with a senior expert resolving disagreements and revising responses when needed; other characters' adjudicated responses to the same scenario serve as distractors. In the main evaluation, models receive character IDs and occupations, scenarios, and options, with retrieved memories added in memory-augmented settings. Detailed personality-and-value profiles are withheld. We evaluate 16 LLMs under No-Retrieval, Naive-RA

translated_title: HEART-Bench：大语言模型能否做出与人设一致的决策？
translated_abstract: 交互式娱乐和社交应用中的大语言模型智能体，包括AI伴侣、角色扮演角色和人设克隆体，需要做出基于个性和过往经历的决策。我们提出HEART-Bench来评估基于记忆的人设一致性回答选择能力。该基准将11个以大五人格为框架构建的合成角色（每个角色拥有1,000条自传体记忆）与64个由DIAMONDS框架指导设计的决策场景相结合，构成673道多选题。领域专家独立比较候选回答，由资深专家解决分歧并在必要时修改回答；其他角色对同一场景的裁决后回答被用作干扰项。在主要评估中，模型会获得角色ID和职业、场景以及选项，并在记忆增强设置中额外提供检索到的记忆，而详细的人格与价值观档案则被隐藏。我们在无检索、朴素检索增强等设置下评估了16个大语言模型。
tldr: 提出HEART-Bench基准，通过11个拥有自传体记忆的大五人格合成角色和64个决策场景构成的673道多选题，评估16个大语言模型能否在检索记忆的辅助下做出与人设一致且基于记忆的决策。
